reviews.text:
The two Doctors are so sweet and kind, they take care of the furry ones with so much love.
I bring my 19-year-old cat.
I always feel comfortable.

Fantastic and dedicated veterinarians who truly care about the health of the animals entrusted to them. I can't thank them enough for treating my cat and nursing him back to health with love and compassion.
Ilaria is very kind! Very cheerful and patient ♥️☀️
Kristel will always be one of us!

I'm sorry to have to leave a negative review.
I went to the clinic to get my dog ​​vaccinated, telling the doctor that we could feel a lump in her abdomen when touching her in certain positions.
The doctor couldn't feel anything and downplayed the issue, so I went to another veterinary clinic for an abdominal ultrasound.
The result was a mass in her spleen that will need to be removed soon, as well as a mass in her heart (suspected hemangiosarcoma).

I'm so sorry to leave this clinic, but their lack of concern would have cost us dearly, possibly with internal bleeding.

Wonderful veterinarians. We visited Milano and needed to complete a few things for our dog, including a blood test, annual vaccine, new prescription, and Rabies Titration test. They helped us with everything and the prices were very reasonable.

They speak very good English so communication was easy. Lovely team and very accommodating of our tight schedule.

Highly recommended!!!

I booked an appointment to obtain a travel permit for my cat. The cost, which was communicated to me via email, was €60. My partner showed up for the appointment and they convinced her to get a flea treatment, which came to a final cost of €120. I had specified in the email that the cat didn't need anything because he was up to date on all his vaccinations and flea treatments. Maybe all clinics are like this, but I'd definitely avoid this one, or at least stay on top of things.

Competent and helpful veterinarians
Prices are average for Milan

An excellent place, which twice saw me without an appointment for emergencies, something my vet has never done, despite being there every month.
The welcome was excellent, and I found them to be extremely professional.
Excellent veterinary clinic, kind and helpful

Francesca, Ilaria, and Esteban: who better than them? I don't know! Empathy, sensitivity, and kindness, and obviously competence, towards animals, but also... towards us humans. It's not a small thing, it's a lot!
